nearbyAttractions.name: Sri Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple)
nearbyAttractions.description: The holiest Gurdwara of Sikhism, famous for its inspiring golden architecture, serene holy sarovar, and round-the-clock Langar.

nearbyAttractions.name: Jallianwala Bagh
nearbyAttractions.description: Historic memorial park honoring national heroes, featuring the eternal flame and preserved historic bullet-marked walls.

nearbyAttractions.name: Partition Museum
nearbyAttractions.description: The world's first museum dedicated to the stories, artifacts, and memories of the 1947 partition of India.

nearbyAttractions.name: Gobindgarh Fort
nearbyAttractions.description: Historic 18th-century military fort featuring 7D sound & light shows, folk dance performances, and Punjabi heritage exhibitions.

nearbyAttractions.name: Durgiana Temple
nearbyAttractions.description: Beautiful Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Durga, surrounded by a sacred water body and grand marble architecture.

nearbyAttractions.name: Wagah Border Ceremony
nearbyAttractions.description: World-renowned daily military flag-lowering ceremony conducted jointly by Indian BSF and Pakistan Rangers.

testimonials.name: Gurpreet Singh
testimonials.comment: Very clean hotel right on G.T. Road. Easy parking for our SUV and very short drive to Golden Temple. Staff was extremely helpful!

testimonials.name: Ananya Sharma
testimonials.comment: Dewdrop Shankh is brand new and the family room was spacious enough for 4 of us. Hot water 24 hours and excellent room service.

testimonials.name: Rajesh Malhotra
testimonials.comment: Stayed during a corporate trip to Amritsar. Smooth check-in, GST invoice provided promptly, and clean premium bathrooms.

policies.title: Check-in & Check-out
policies.content: Standard Check-in time is 12:00 PM and Check-out time is 11:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out is subject to room availability and prior notification.

policies.title: ID Requirement
policies.content: All guests (Indian & Foreign nationals) must present a valid government-issued photo ID with address proof (Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID, Driving License) at check-in. PAN cards are not accepted.

policies.title: Cancellation Policy
policies.content: Free cancellation up to 48 hours prior to check-in date. Cancellations made within 48 hours will incur a 1-night room charge.

policies.title: Child & Extra Bed Policy
policies.content: Children up to 5 years stay free of charge when using existing bedding. Extra bed/mattress can be arranged upon request for an additional fee.

policies.title: Pet Policy
policies.content: Pets are not allowed on the hotel premises to ensure comfort and hygiene for all guests.
